sources.summary: Located in Itacaré , on the southern coast of Bahia, Bungalow Txai occupies a high slope facing the sea. From the site, the view opens nearly 180 degrees over the ocean, rising above the existing palm and coconut trees. Secluded in the midst of nature, the house is organized around a direct relationship with the topography, vegetation, and climate.
